chapter: Early music and bands on the coast
title: Julius's own band over the lake and the fish fry jam sessions
summary: After the brothers split up he led a band on the coast and played with Agnes Oce and Giger, with fish fry jams.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, did you ever? We had the three, up until, uh, Cap was about, maybe twenty-eight or thirty, or maybe thirty-three years old, something like that. Well, I got up a band over the lake, and I used to send the cap to come over and play with me over there when he was available. But I had a band over there for a long time. And, uh, between, plus playing with, uh, you remember Agnes Oce, he was a little, he was a saxophone player over here?
I never knew him. No. I heard him.

His daddy was named Agnes Oce, well, he had a band. I used to play with him. Some little bot had a band over there. I used to play with him. Then, uh, Agnes's, uh, brother-in-law, Giger, he used to get band jobs over there, and I used to play over there with him, you see.
Yeah, Giger, he was a bass player over there.
You don't know his right name.
Who was in some of the box bands?

Uh, I was in his band. He had, uh, Paul Maurice, he was in his band. And, uh, this fellow Giger, he was in the band playing bass. And then Walter Benoit, he was, sometimes he'd play, uh, trumpet with him, you know. In other words, just, he'd get his band and just call me a call, this one or that one, you know, just, uh, just to get his band together. Whenever he get a job. And, uh. stuff

We used to have a time over there and then sometime like we call a jam session over here. Well, we used to get together and say they're going to have a fish fry and have gumbo and this and that. And they'd get together and they'd cook. The people would cook and then we'd eat and play. And didn't know when to stop playing and all that. It was a kick.
